entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A vampire assassin from Ravnica and former champion of House Dimir, later a detective at the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: The detective who captures Etrata, then recruits her as his aide and investigates the Karlov Manor murders.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of spies that Etrata served as champion; it was seemingly destroyed during the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: The detective agency that employs Etrata.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild-ruled city plane where Etrata lives and works.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault on Ravnica that Etrata helped resist, after which House Dimir lost its leadership.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Ravnican leader for whom Etrata acted as a contact in the resistance; her funeral is being arranged at Karlov Cathedral.

entities.name: Karlov Manor
entities.description: The manor where the celebration was held and Zegana was assassinated.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: A guild leader who was assassinated at the Karlov Manor celebration.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A character who helps capture Etrata, later tells Proft three clues and helps seal Oba in a stasis capsule.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A character who assists in Etrata's capture at Karlov Manor.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: An assassin hired to kill Proft who attacks him and Etrata at the safehouse.

entities.name: Kylox
entities.description: A scientist friend of Proft and agent of Niv-Mizzet, abducted by goblins and stabbed to death.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A goblin criminal whose safehouse Etrata and Proft raid to reach Kylox.

entities.name: Izoni
entities.description: A character in the undercity of the Sixth Precinct who analyzes the yellow-gray powder.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: The central dryad of Trostani, who organized the murders in retribution against those she considered traitors to the plane; she is sealed in a stasis capsule.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The Selesnya guildmaster, whose central dryad is Oba; likely gave Etrata her Selesnya robes.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnya tree where Proft reveals the killer and where Oba attacks her accusers.

entities.name: Yarus
entities.description: A Gruul centaur whom Etrata saves from Oba's attack.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: A Dimir leader whom Etrata claims has died; Proft suspects this is a lie.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon who began the secret Omenpath Project and contracts Proft and Etrata.

entities.name: Omenpath Project
entities.description: Niv-Mizzet's secret experiment to understand the Omenpaths opening across Ravnica and other worlds.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A plane whose door opened on Ravnica; Etrata and Proft help retrieve Nashi from it.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A character who goes to Duskmourn to retrieve Nashi.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A character who goes to Duskmourn to retrieve Nashi.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A character who goes to Duskmourn to retrieve Nashi.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A character who goes to Duskmourn to retrieve Nashi.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A character who goes to Duskmourn to retrieve Nashi.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A character retrieved from Duskmourn.

events.summary: Etrata fights in the resistance to the New Phyrexian Invasion as one of Teysa Karlov's contacts; afterward, with Dimir seemingly destroyed, she loses her purpose and works as a free agent.
events.quote: Etrata fought in the resistance to the New Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: Etrata attends the Karlov Manor celebration disguised as a Selesnya guild member.
events.quote: she attended the celebration at Karlov Manor in disguise as a Selesnya guild member

events.summary: After Zegana is assassinated, Etrata is discovered and captured by Proft with help from Kaya and Kellan.
events.quote: she was discovered and captured by Alquist Proft

events.summary: Three days after her capture, Proft helps Etrata escape Azorius custody to assist in the investigation.
events.quote: Proft helped Etrata escape Azorius custody to assist in the investigation

events.summary: Etrata and Proft find yellow-gray powder at the safehouse and are attacked by Massacre Girl, whom Etrata forces to stand down.
events.quote: they were attacked by Massacre Girl

events.summary: Goblins abduct Kylox from his laboratory; Etrata and Proft track them to Krenko's safehouse, where Etrata dispatches his minions and an enchanted citizen fatally stabs Kylox.
events.quote: a citizen burst into the window bound for Krenko and fatally stabbed Kylox

events.summary: Etrata uses her psychic abilities to lift the enchantment from the stabber, revealing he was oblivious to his actions.
events.quote: Etrata used her psychic abilities to remove the enchantment on him

events.summary: Izoni reveals that the powder derives from a living thing not native to Ravnica.
events.quote: She cooperated, revealing that the powder was derived from a living thing not native to Ravnica.

events.summary: At Vitu-Ghazi, the detective reveals that Oba organized the murders as retribution against traitors of the plane, and that Etrata was Zegana's killer.
events.quote: the detective revealed that Oba, the central dryad of Trostani

events.summary: When Oba attacks, Etrata takes a branch through the chest to save the centaur Yarus.
events.quote: Etrata jumped in the way to save the Gruul centaur Yarus

events.summary: Etrata feigns death, then helps Kaya seal Oba in a stasis capsule.
events.quote: helped Kaya seal Oba in a stasis capsule

events.summary: Etrata tells Proft she will keep serving as his aide because they became friends; she claims Dimir is weak and Lazav dead.
events.quote: Etrata told Proft that she had decided to continue serving as his aide

events.summary: Etrata and Proft are contracted to assist Niv-Mizzet with the Omenpath Project.
events.quote: Etrata and Proft were ultimately contracted to assist the Firemind with his work.

events.summary: When a door to Duskmourn opens on Ravnica, Etrata and Proft help retrieve Nashi from the plane.
events.quote: When a door to Duskmourn opened on Ravnica, the two assisted Kaito Shizuki

relations.quote: a former champion of House Dimir
Etrata told Proft that she had decided to continue serving as his aide

relations.note: they became friends during the investigation
relations.quote: they had become friends during the investigation

relations.note: Proft confirms Etrata was the killer
relations.quote: He also confirmed that Etrata was Zegana's killer

relations.note: Etrata helps seal Oba in stasis
relations.quote: helped Kaya seal Oba in a stasis capsule
